**Finding: missing** (rule IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data)

The MSA has no IP/data ownership provision at all:
- **§ 14(b)** (p0065) is the only proprietary-rights statement and covers only names, trademarks and logos.
- **§ 6(a)** (p0025) makes AP *liable* for its Content and IP rights therein, but does not allocate ownership.
- **§ 9(b)(vii)–(viii)** (p0039–p0040) confirm Kubient owns the Service, Auction Platform *and "products delivered hereunder"* — i.e. deliverables sit with the vendor with no licence-back beyond the limited, revocable platform licence in § 2, which terminates on expiry (§ 4(c)(ii)).
- Nothing addresses ownership of the Requests or the visitor/audience data Kubient collects and stores under § 9(b)(iii).

No AP IP or data is affirmatively assigned to Kubient, so this is not walk-away territory, but neither the preferred nor the fallback position is met (no Customer Data ownership sentence, no perpetual deliverables licence).

**Redline validated (ok:true):** new § 6(b) inserted after p0025 giving AP ownership of Content, Properties, Requests and Customer Data; confirming Kubient retains the Auction Platform and background IP; assigning any AP-specific deliverables with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded Kubient IP; and excluding joint ownership. Fallback (licence in lieu of assignment) is offered in the comment.
